item.title: Toronto Maple Leafs could still turn disaster season into bright future
item.description: It's dire times for the Toronto Maple Leafs. For the first time in nearly a decade, it feels like the Maple Leafs are at serious risk of missing the playoffs. item.title: Toronto drivers spent equivalent of four entire days stuck in traffic last year
item.description: People in Toronto love to complain about traffic, and it looks like drivers have every right to make a fuss over how bad commuting is in the city.Tech company TomTom released its annual traffic index, which showed how bad Toronto congestion really is. In 2025, drivers spent a total of 100 hours (that's four days and four hours) stuck in traffic.
